description: Decorative fixed-position scroll progress bar (CSS scroll-timeline for the document, JS for data-for targets).

attributes.name: data-for
attributes.description: ID of the element whose bounds define the progress range. Observed. If the element does not exist the bar tracks document scroll until it appears.

attributes.name: data-position
attributes.description: Viewport edge the bar is anchored to.

cssProperties.name: --reading-progress-color
cssProperties.description: Fill colour (default var(--color-accent)); Highlight in forced-colors mode.

cssProperties.name: --reading-progress-offset
cssProperties.description: Distance from the anchored edge, e.g. a sticky header's height (default 0).

structure.description: Optional SSR child; created when absent. Always aria-hidden: the bar is decorative.
